ProductApprovalOutput.description: The approval record, as echoed by compile/status output.

snapshot_path.description: Project-root-relative path of the immutable snapshot file.

approval.description: The approval record, when one exists.

artifact_problems.description: Byte-verification problems against the committed manifest (empty = every committed artifact matches its recorded hash).

committed_phase.description: The committed lowering phase, when a manifest exists.

committed_spec_digest.description: The committed manifest's spec digest, when one exists.

fulfill_state.description: The persisted fulfillment state tag, when one exists.

journal_rows.description: Number of fulfillment journal rows recorded for this product.

output_model.description: The resolved output model, when the spec parses.

product.description: The product name the status was asked for.

snapshot_intact.description: Whether the approval snapshot's bytes still digest to the recorded value. `null` without an approval; `false` is tamper.

spec_digest.description: The working spec's digest, when it parses.

spec_error.description: Why the spec failed to parse, when it did not.

spec_matches_approval.description: Whether the working spec equals the approved revision. `null` when either side is missing.

staging_journal_present.description: Whether an uncommitted staging journal is pending. Status never mutates; the next compile resolves it.
